libretto.translation: What does the name mean?

libretto.text: Nie, dünkt mich, hört’ ich ihn nennen.
libretto.translation: Never, it seems to me, have I heard it named.
What, strong in fear,
my courage invented,
when, victorious, it lives,

libretto.text: leg’ es den Sinn dir dar!
libretto.translation: let it lay its meaning before you!

libretto.text: Deines Auges Glut erglänzte mir schon:
libretto.translation: The glow of your eye shone on me before:

libretto.text: so blickte der Greis grüßend auf mich,
libretto.translation: so the old man looked at me in greeting,

libretto.text: als der Traurigen Trost er gab.
libretto.translation: when he gave comfort to the sorrowful one.

libretto.text: An dem Blick erkannt’ ihn sein Kind –
libretto.translation: by his gaze his child recognized him –

libretto.text: schon wollt’ ich beim Namen ihn nennen!
libretto.translation: I was about to call him by name!

libretto.translation: He who made it for you has now decreed your death:

libretto.text: seine Tugend nimmt er dem Schwert.
libretto.translation: he takes its virtue from the sword.

libretto.text: Schweig, – und schrecke die Schlummernde nicht!
libretto.translation: Be silent – and do not startle the sleeper!
